<h2>Intel DPC++ Support — SYCL 2020 and oneAPI Development for CLion</h2>

<p>
Develop for CPUs, GPUs, and FPGAs with a single codebase. Intel DPC++ Support brings comprehensive SYCL 2020 development features to CLion — from intelligent code completion to GPU debugging and VTune profiling integration.
</p>

<h3>Language Support</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Full SYCL 2020 syntax highlighting with keyword and type recognition</li>
  <li>Dedicated file types: .dpcpp and .dp.cpp</li>
  <li>Context-aware code completion for sycl::queue, sycl::buffer, accessors, and kernels</li>
  <li>Documentation on hover for SYCL APIs</li>
  <li>Semantic highlighting with DPC++ annotator</li>
</ul>

<h3>Toolchain and Build</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Automatic Intel oneAPI toolchain detection</li>
  <li>CMake integration with DPC++ compiler configuration</li>
  <li>Project templates for quick-start DPC++ development</li>
  <li>Six live templates: syclqueue, syclbuffer, syclsubmit, syclparallel, syclaccess, syclusm</li>
</ul>

<h3>Debugging and Profiling (Premium)</h3>
<ul>
  <li>gdb-oneapi integration for GPU kernel debugging</li>
  <li>GPU thread visualization and kernel stepping</li>
  <li>Intel VTune Profiler integration (GPU hotspots, offload, memory analysis)</li>
  <li>Intel Advisor roofline analysis and offload modeling</li>
  <li>Kernel occupancy calculator and bandwidth estimator</li>
</ul>

<h3>Advanced Features (Premium)</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Device Explorer tool window for browsing CPU, GPU, and FPGA devices</li>
  <li>SYCL code quality and performance inspections</li>
  <li>FPGA optimization analyzer with resource estimation</li>
  <li>Multi-device orchestrator for workload distribution</li>
  <li>AI-powered optimization suggestions</li>
  <li>Live kernel editing with hot-reload</li>
  <li>Intel DevCloud integration for cloud compilation on 7 device types</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pricing</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Free (Open Source):</b> Syntax highlighting, code completion, live templates, CMake integration, project templates</li>
  <li><b>Professional:</b> GPU debugging, VTune profiling, device explorer, kernel analysis, FPGA optimization, AI assistant</li>
  <li><b>Enterprise:</b> LSP integration, team collaboration, SSO, CI/CD integration, admin dashboard</li>
  <li><i>Academic/Non-profit: 50% discount</i></li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
  <li>CLion 2023.2 or later</li>
  <li>Intel oneAPI Base Toolkit 2024.0+</li>
  <li>CMake 3.20+</li>
  <li>Linux, Windows, or macOS</li>
</ul>
